units.sourceHTML: 10.11.1 Controlling the Verbosity of patch

units.text: You can cause ⟦0⟧ to produce more messages by using the ⟦1⟧ option. For example, when you give this option, the message ‘⟦2⟧’ indicates that ⟦3⟧ is reading text in the patch file, attempting to determine whether there is a patch in that text, and if so, what kind of patch it is.
units.sourceHTML: You can cause patch to produce more messages by using the --verbose option. For example, when you give this option, the message ‘Hmm...’ indicates that patch is reading text in the patch file, attempting to determine whether there is a patch in that text, and if so, what kind of patch it is.

units.text: You can inhibit all terminal output from ⟦0⟧, unless an error occurs, by using the ⟦1⟧, ⟦2⟧, or ⟦3⟧ option.
units.sourceHTML: You can inhibit all terminal output from patch, unless an error occurs, by using the -s, --quiet, or --silent option.
